title: Calendar
summary: See every note and reminder in one month-view — offline.

cards.heading: What Calendar does
cards.body: Calendar shows every note with a date or reminder on a single month grid. Tap any day to see the notes attached to it.

cards.heading: Adding a note to a day
cards.body: Open any note and tap the bell icon. Pick a date and time — Iron Rabbit places it on the calendar and sends a local reminder when it's due.

cards.heading: Editing a scheduled note
cards.body: Tap a day in the calendar to see its notes. Tap a note to open the editor. Change the date or clear the reminder to remove it from the grid.

cards.heading: Tip: Swipe between months
cards.body: **Tip:** Swipe left or right on the grid to jump months. Tap the month name at the top to jump directly to any month or year.

cards.heading: Common mistake
cards.body: Reminders need OS permission. If nothing pops up when a note is due, open Android Settings → Iron Rabbit → Notifications and turn them on.
